units.source_text: 我站在镜湖地这边，金周与地子相隔，西斜的夕阳照射着金阁的正面。

en.t: I stood on this side of Kyoko Pond, with Kinshu and Chishi between me and the temple grounds, while the westering evening sun shone on the front of the Golden Pavilion.

units.source_text: 漱清亭在对岸左侧半隐半现。

en.t: On the left side of the opposite bank, Sosei-tei was half hidden and half visible.

units.source_text: 金阁精致的影子，投落在稀疏地漂浮着藻类和水草的池面上。

en.t: The delicate reflection of the Golden Pavilion fell on the surface of the pond, where algae and water plants floated sparsely.

units.source_text: 看上去，这投影更加完整。

en.t: Seen that way, the reflection looked even more complete.

units.source_text: 在各层房檐里倒摇曳着夕照在池水的反射。

en.t: Within the eaves of each story, the evening light reflected from the pond shimmered upside down.

units.source_text: 比起四周的明亮来，这房檐里侧的反射更鲜明耀眼，

en.t: Compared with the brightness all around, the reflections on the inner sides of these eaves were sharper and more dazzling,

units.source_text: 恍如一幅夸张远近法的绘画，金阁的气势给人一种需要仰望的感觉。

en.t: as if in a painting with exaggerated perspective, giving the Golden Pavilion a presence that made one feel compelled to look up at it.
